title: Fix Design App Toolbar Test Gating
description: Stabilize the Sketchpad Design Playwright test by gating toolbar and filter assertions on actual visible controls and diagram geometry, hardening deterministic fallbacks for piece creation and connection deletion, and removing fragile focus/locator assumptions.
summary: Stabilized the Sketchpad Design Playwright case by gating toolbar and filter assertions on actual rendered UI/diagram geometry, removing fragile canvas focus assumptions, and adding deterministic store-backed fallbacks for piece creation and connection deletion.
